citation: Q. Xi, R. Bittner, J. Pauwels, X. Ye, J. P. Bello, GuitarSet: A Dataset for Guitar Transcription, ISMIR 2018.
splitPolicy: Reserve lead-sheet index 3 across all styles/tempi/players/parts; index 1/2 tuning. Declared before analysis.

corpus.readinessMessage: 15 repeated recording groups require deduplication or identity review (0 cross the tuning/held-out boundary); needs held-out stable-electronic coverage; missing required Phase 0 coverage: house, techno, drum-and-bass, hip-hop, breakbeat, rock-live-drums, disco, ambient, sparse-no-percussion, stable-electronic, meter-3-4-or-6-8, tempo-ramp-or-switch, tempo-70-140-ambiguity, tempo-85-170-ambiguity

tempo.verdict: confidence decreases between one or more buckets

key.verdict: requires observations in all three confidence buckets

limitations: Short solo acoustic guitar excerpts do not cover required electronic/live-drum strata.
Global tempo/key and backing-track-derived grids are independent of Spotify but not manually performed onset annotations.
Shared harmonic vocabulary may remain across lead-sheet groups; no composition-independence claim.
Tuning-split metrics are development diagnostics, never release qualification.
No browser baseline, supported-platform comparison, or perceptual score is included.
Measured throughput is analyzer-only, excluding persistence and UI.
